host: Apple M2 Pro, 32 GB RAM, macOS 26.7.3
compute_units: SDK defaults: CoreML CPU and Neural Engine
probe: benchmarks/asr/model-probe (one process per model and fixture set, run under /usr/bin/time -l)
metric: fixtures: benchmarks/asr/analyze.py (casefold, tokens [a-z]+ and [0-9]+, word edit distance); LibriSpeech: benchmarks/asr/score_librispeech.py (casefold, tokens [a-z']+ and [0-9]+)
notes: Outputs are the text returned by the SDK. No SottoASR dictionary, vocabulary or cleanup step was applied.
median_ms and p95_ms are per-clip decode times after one warm-up clip. The long sets have one clip, so both equal its decode time.
peak_rss_bytes is the largest ru_maxrss the probe reported in that process.
The nemotron-unified-auto-int8 holdout process reported a 0.16 s load and 72 MiB peak RSS, which is not comparable with the other processes. The research note reports no peak RSS for that variant.
Per-utterance LibriSpeech outputs are not included, only aggregates and paired comparisons.

The bootstrap intervals use 2,000 resamples of utterances with random.seed(0). The two comparisons against v3 come from one run (v3,ultra,nemotron-unified-int8), the comparison against ultra from a second run (ultra,nemotron-unified-int8).

v3.name: Parakeet TDT v3
v3.loading: APFS clone of the installed app cache (INT8 encoder), AsrModels.loadLocal, no download

fixture_sets.dev: benchmarks/asr/development-40.json synthesized by prepare.py: 40 clips, 2 voices
fixture_sets.holdout: benchmarks/asr/independent-24.json synthesized by prepare.py --independent: 48 clips, 2 voices
fixture_sets.dev-pad: the dev clips with 0.5 s of silence before and after
fixture_sets.long-dev: the 40 dev clips in one 149.7 s file, each clip followed by 0.6 s of silence
fixture_sets.long-holdout: the 48 holdout clips in one 172.5 s file, each clip followed by 0.6 s of silence
